stories.headline: Milwaukee sweep the Dodgers to reach the World Series
stories.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have swept the Los Angeles Dodgers in the National League Championship Series. It takes them to the World Series for the first time since 1982. They came from behind in all four games, the first team to sweep a best-of-seven postseason series that way.

stories.headline: UniCredit is cleared to take control of Commerzbank
stories.summary: The European Central Bank has given UniCredit permission to raise its stake in Commerzbank beyond 30%, with no limit on how much it could own. The Italian bank's takeover bid had already taken it to 47.6% of the German lender by July 2026. It expects to take control by the end of the year.

stories.headline: The biggest crayfish turns up in a museum collection
stories.summary: A biologist pulled an unusually large Crawzilla crawdad out of the mud during a biological survey in Kentucky. That started a search through preserved collections for the biggest crayfish anyone had kept. The list came to 20 very large specimens from 18 different species.

explanations: They swept the Los Angeles Dodgers in four games. Milwaukee came from behind in every one of them, the first team to sweep a best-of-seven postseason series with four comeback wins.
The Brewers last reached the World Series in 1982. Jake Bauers won the award for most valuable player in this year's series, the first time a Brewer has taken it.
The European Central Bank cleared UniCredit to go beyond 30%, with no limit on how much it could own. Its takeover bid had already taken it to 47.6% of Commerzbank by July 2026.
The 20 largest specimens came from 18 different species. The results were published in the scientific journal Ecology.
The record-holder measured 86.6 mm, leaving out its tail, claws and antennae. It is a Tennessee bottlebrush crayfish, preserved in the collection at West Liberty University in West Virginia.

sources.excerpt: In baseball, the Milwaukee Brewers sweep the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NLCS to advance to the 2026 World Series, their first since 1982.
Aaron Ashby pitched three innings for the save and the Brewers swept the Dodgers as they reached the World Series for the first time since 1982.
Having come from behind in all four games, the Brewers became the first team to have swept an opponent in a best-of-seven postseason series with four straight comeback victories.
Jake Bauers won the NLCS MVP, the first time for a Brewer.
The European Central Bank authorizes UniCredit to raise its stake in Commerzbank above 30% without an upper limit, allowing the Italian bank to proceed toward taking control of the German lender.
On October 15, 2026, UniCredit said European Central Bank had given it permission to increase its stake in Commerzbank beyond 30%, with no limit on how much it could own.
The takeover bid resulted in UniCredit increasing its take in Commerzbank to 47.6% by July 2026.
The investigation began when Caitlin Bloomer pulled an enormous Crawzilla crawdad from the mud during a biological survey in Kentucky.
Their search produced a list of 20 exceptionally large individuals representing 18 different species. The results were published in the scientific journal Ecology.

The biggest specimen belonged to a Tennessee bottlebrush crayfish preserved in the collection at West Liberty University in West Virginia. It measured an impressive 86.6 millimeters, or approximately 3.4 inches, excluding its tail, claws, and antennae.
